svg.aria-label: Strengths A 0.8, B 0.4 and C 0.6. Minimum gives 0.40 and maximum 0.80; a weighted mean with weights 2, 1 and 1 gives 0.65. With review when the result is below 0.7, minimum and mean ask for review and maximum does not.
